title: Roasted Australian Roast Vegan Dish
description: A flavorful and nutritious vegan dish made with roasted Australian roast, perfect for a comforting meal.
instructions: Peel and chop the carrots and potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
In a large bowl, toss the chopped vegetables with olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the Australian roast to the bowl and toss to combine.
Spread the mixture on a baking sheet and roast for 45 minutes.
After 45 minutes, reduce the oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue roasting for another 20-25 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
